{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check site distribution
site_severity = df_dedup.groupby('site')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True).unstack(fill_value=0)
print(site_severity)"}
